units.source_text: 我又问他打算如何处理自己的爱情，是仅限于告白呢，还是想要进一步达到实际的目的。

en.t: I asked him again what he meant to do about his love: would it go no further than a confession, or did he intend to press on toward some actual result?

units.source_text: 可是对这个问题，他没有回答，默默地向坡下走去。

en.t: But to this question he gave no answer, and walked silently down the slope.

units.source_text: 我请求他不要隐瞒，把心里想的都告诉我，他清楚地回答，没有什么可瞒着你的。

en.t: I asked him not to hide anything from me and to tell me everything that was on his mind; he answered clearly that there was nothing he needed to hide from me.

units.source_text: 但是对于我刚才问到的事情，他却一句也没有回答。

en.t: But as for the matter I had just asked about, he did not answer a single word.

units.source_text: 走在大街上，我也不好停下来打破砂锅问到底，也只好作罢了。

en.t: Since we were walking along the street, I could hardly stop him and keep pressing the matter to the bottom, so I had no choice but to let it drop.
